critical_code_review_comments: Security headers middleware correctly applies X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, HSTS, and CSP with frame-ancestors 'none' + object-src 'none' on ALL responses (verified on /api/courses, /api/intelligence/briefing, /api/health via HEAD).

CSP is well-formed but still permits 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval' on script-src — this is a pragmatic React/CRA constraint (Emotion + emergentagent overlay). Consider nonce-based CSP in a follow-up hardening pass.

DOMPurify sanitize is applied AFTER the markdown-to-HTML regex — correct order (sanitizer sees final markup). Bold/em rendering confirmed in the browser: 2 <strong> + 4 <em> tags rendered inside try-a-lesson widget, 0 <script> tags injected.
TryALesson error handling now uses console.error on demo lesson fetch failure — good silent-failure remediation.
Quiz.jsx useCallback(loadSession, [slug]) + useEffect([loadSession]) is the correct pattern. Timer counted 30:00 → 29:57 in 3s with no infinite-render or update-depth warnings.
Quiz option keys use `${q.id}-opt-${oi}` — stable across question-order shuffles. No duplicate-key React warnings during 15-question render.
